raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Charlie hit my Brick 6. He's clearly holding a grudge over the 7 I rolled earlier. Alice is cheering him on. I need to keep my cool; reacting too aggressively will only cement their alliance. I'll play the victim of their 'fairness' and wait for a better opening.","note_to_self":"Charlie used a Knight to move the robber to Hex 5 (Brick 6), blocking my primary brick source and stealing from me. Charlie and Alice are currently coordinated in their rhetoric against me.","say_outloud":"A bit dramatic for a simple knight, don't you think, Charlie? I'm just a humble merchant trying to keep the wheat flowing."}
